Automatic Master Data Transfer
Automatic Master Data Transfer
Use
You use this function to transfer the contract account master data from legacy or operational systems.
Features
Data is generally transferred in two steps:
The relevant data is read from the operational system and placed in a sequential file (operational system sender structure) by the data selection program. This transaction takes place outside of the SAP system and is not supported by SAP programs. Therefore the data selection program can make changes to data at this point.
The SAP transfer program reads the data from the sender structure, changes the data, and places the data in the receiver structure. Data can be changed or converted in this last step.
Activities
For more information, and the programs involved, see the Implementation Guide for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable:
